scope: Read/PAUSE while contended in the existing mandatory kernel no-sleep and scheduler-runtime owners.

implementation.acquisition: After an unsuccessful compare_exchange_weak, preserve the original PAUSE/IRQ window and read the lock with Relaxed ordering until free; retry the original Acquire CAS. A read never grants ownership. No scheduler call, allocation, timer or additional backoff.
implementation.preserved: Reentrance, rank, owner CPU/depth, original IF=1 IRQ/TLB progress windows and IF=0 exclusion, release publication and context-switch release after durable outgoing RSP. All code outside the two acquire bodies is byte-identical.
implementation.metrics: Operational acquisition/collision counters and base/detail separation unchanged. Detail wait_spins/max_wait_spins now count PAUSE wait cycles including read-only cycles, previously failed CAS attempts; no direct cross-version RMW-count comparison.
implementation.ownership: Existing kernel lock owners; no new module, ABI, public counter or userland workload.

source_audit.review: Atomic relaxed loads only decide when to retry the original Acquire CAS. Original pause and saved-IF IRQ window execute on every failed-acquire wait cycle. Owner/rank/depth, release order, task RSP handoff, error handling and acquisition/collision counters are unchanged. Detail spin counts now represent pause cycles including read-only waiting; not comparable as CAS-attempt counts.

scoped_guest.scope: Original owned SMP/TLB/parallel owner request plus selected sync/unwind and original IF probes. No new runtime case, public API or permanent observer.
scoped_guest.limits: Actual normal SMP4 run; original functional oracles preserved. Exact original switch/RSP and release bodies additionally verified unchanged in source audit. No exhaustive interleaving or fairness bound claim.

comparison_previous.observation: One final run per artifact; descriptive comparison without causal gain/parity claim. All deltas retained, unchanged workload/reference, no score-selection rerun.

test_policy: One normal SMP4 guest bundles the original selected THREAD /KERNEL:SYNC (sync+unwind, four IF probes) and owned SMP/TLB/parallel-owner cases. Original oracles unchanged. No new runtime case, lock microbenchmark, general suite or broad catalogue.

performance_policy.reason: Runtime synchronization changes may affect all scheduler/memory workloads; exactly one final STANDARD Suite2 SMP4 with unchanged full DevCenter import and lossless GET5/30/6. Compare descriptively to 0.84.25 run3b8ef73b-76c0-4c78-9bc8-4bfc8a398c52.

limits: Existing functional cases and source review cover affected contracts; no exhaustive interleaving, fairness latency bound or isolated lock-speedup claim.
